# Is your self-hosted GitHub Actions runner exposed to a fork?

> Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and find every job that runs on a self-hosted label in a workflow triggered by pull_request, pull_request_target, workflow_run, or issue_comment — the exact pattern GitHub's own docs warn against on public repos. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
